name: interpft
expr: y_v = interpft(v, 16); y_dim1 = interpft(M, 8); y_dim2 = interpft(M, 4, 2);
comment: Sig: Y = interpft(X, n[, dim]). Band-limited (FFT-based) interpolation to n samples. Default dim = first non-singleton. Vector form preserves originals at integer multiples of original spacing. Matrix dim=1 interpolates each column; dim=2 interpolates each row. tol=1e-12.
